title: People’s Mañanera September 11
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available[here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Chiapas: Less Violence, More Peace and Well-Being  
** In Chiapas, homicides fell by 64%, and the recovery of areas of the state
made it possible to reopen schools and restore services provided by the
Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS) and the IMSS-Bienestar healthcare
program. In addition, 267 “Jornadas por la Paz” (Days for Peace) events are
strengthening the strategy to address the root causes of violence.

**Mexico Is Doing Well: Employment and Economic Confidence Grow  
** Mexico remains among the OECD countries with the lowest unemployment rates.
President Claudia Sheinbaum said that the country is doing well and will do
even better, despite the international situation and U.S. tariffs. She also
noted that the Economic Package was well received.

**Strengthening Education in Public Schools  
** Sheinbaum explained that her criticism of the Program for International
Student Assessment (PISA) stems from pedagogical, not political, differences,
and that a math test alone does not reflect the quality of the entire
education system. Nevertheless, math, reading, and writing will be reinforced.

**INE: Elections with Certainty and Without Excesses  
** The President described the 42 billion pesos (US$2.47 billion) requested by
the National Electoral Institute (INE) for 2027 as “exaggerated,” compared to
the 37 billion pesos (US$2.18 billion) she estimates based on 2024 figures
plus inflation. She also called for clarification regarding unfolded ballots
to ensure certainty and prevent irregularities.

**Sovereignty: While Mexico Celebrates Its Independence, the PAN Is in Europe  
** The President questioned the symbolism of National Action Party (PAN)
leaders being in Europe as the election campaigns begin and ahead of the
Independence Day celebration: “They have the right… but just as the election
campaign is getting underway, they are in Europe. Well, that has its own
symbolism,” she said.
